title: "uv-python inline-only parity"
engine: uv-python
format: html
execute:

This document has no fenced Python chunks, but inline Python still executes: `{python} 40 + 2`.

Plain inline strings escape Pandoc inline markup triggers: `{python} "$INLINE_DOLLAR$ ~INLINE_SUB~ ^INLINE_SUPER^ **INLINE_STRONG_NOT_RAW** <em>INLINE_HTML_NOT_RAW</em>"`.
